content.value: The turning moment diagram of a multi-cylinder engine has been drawn to a vertical scale of 1 mm = 650Nm and a horizontal scale of 1 mm $= 4 . 5 ^ { \circ }$ The areas above and below the mean torque line are -28, +380, -260, +310, -300, +242, -380, +265. and -229 mm². The fluctuation of speed is limited to ±1.8% of the mean speed which is 400 rpm. The density of the rim material is 7000 kg/m³. Determine the mass of the flywheel.
